Pullman Danang Beach Resort - 5-Star Hotel - Official Site
The Resort
Accor is a world-leading augmented hospitality group offering unique experiences in more than 5,100 hotels & residences across 110 destinations. The Group has acquired hospitality expertise for over 50 years, resulting in an unrivaled portfolio of 39 hotel brands, from luxury to economy. The Group also offers digital solutions that maximize distribution, optimize hotel operations & enhance the customer experience.
With ALL Accor Live Limitless , the new daily lifestyle companion, the relationship between the Group & our clients, members & partners evolves from transactional to emotional & unlocks the potential to live, work & play. Beyond accommodation, ALL enables new ways to live, work & play by blending food & beverage with nightlife, wellbeing & co-working.
Accor is deeply committed to sustainable value creation & plays an active role in giving back to the planet & community via its Sustainability program & the Accor Solidarity endowment fund, which gives disadvantaged groups access to employment through professional training.
Pullman Hotels & Resorts set a new tempo in global travel & living, delivering an inspiring, energizing & enriching experience to new entrepreneurs. Pullman welcomes guests with the space to focus, work & play. Forward-thinking, hyper-connected & passionate about art & fitness, Pullman retains the adventurous spirit & open-minded ambition that drove it to become a pioneering travel brand over 150 years ago. Today Pullman features more than 130 properties in vibrant & cosmopolitan destinations around the world.
PULLMAN DANANG BEACH RESORT
Pullman Danang Beach Resort is part of Accor, a world-leading augmented hospitality group offering unique experiences in more than 5,000 hotels & residences across 110 countries.
Central Vietnam’s silver shores provide seaside fun for your holiday. And the up-and-coming city of Da Nang is your urban playground, just waiting to be explored. On the stunning white sands of Bac My An Beach, Pullman Danang Beach Resort is a vibrant oasis of activity & relaxation. Distinctive cuisine & creative beverage concepts are Pullman hallmarks.
IDYLLIC LOCATION
Set on the white sands of Bac My An Beach, overlooking the azure waters of the East Sea, Pullman Danang Beach Resort is the ultimate tropical paradise. Only 15 minutes from Danang International Airport & the city center, and just a short drive from world-class golf courses, our premium resort is perfectly positioned for all types of travelers. With several UNESCO World Heritage sites on its doorstep, Pullman Danang Beach Resort is the ideal start to explore the region s abundance of natural beauty & cultural significance.
ELEGANTLY APPOINTED ROOMS & CREATIVE CULINARY CONCEPTS
Pullman Danang Beach Resort features 186 elegantly appointed guest rooms & cottages , all with private balconies overlooking the beach, infinity pool, or tropical gardens.
Combining Pullman s global expertise with Vietnam s rich culinary heritage, Pullman Danang Beach Resort serves an enticing array of food & beverage concepts. Sample Vietnamese & international delights at Epice Restaurant , exotic Asian specialties & refreshing cocktails at the Infinity Bar & the freshest local seafood on the beach at Azure Beach Lounge .
KEEPING FIT & ACTIVE
Offering a wide variety of daily activities, Pullman Danang Beach Resort allows you to stay active & entertained throughout your stay. From creative classes that connect you & your family with local culture to exciting games & sports that keep you fit & active, our goal is to deliver a fun & memorable vacation experience.
REJUVENATION & WELL-BEING
Overlooking our serene tropical gardens, The Nắng Spa is the perfect place to unwind & indulge your senses. Enjoy a wide range of body treatments at The Nắng  Spa , or work off your tension at our fully equipped Fit Lounge.
MEET & PLAY
With a diverse range of venues , the latest audiovisual technology & professional staff, Pullman Danang Beach Resort ensures that every event runs smoothly & seamlessly. With space for up to 900 delegates, our resort is perfect for all types of functions, from intimate social gatherings to board meetings, themed events, beachfront weddings, cocktail parties & more.
Extensive event facilities and Pullman s unique business services make the resort the ideal choice for your next incentive getaway. When romance is in the air, the Grand Ballroom & private beach are fairy-tale venues for your dream wedding .
